$description: Mantel design tokens. One file, no platform in it. web/src/styles/tokens.css is generated from this and never edited by hand; a future Compose client reads the same file (SDD.md 10).

surface.$description: The page. Near-black, not black: a true black makes dark photographs look like holes.

surface-lift.$description: Anything sitting on the surface: the PIN card, a placeholder tile.

ink.$description: Type. Warm off-white, because pure white vibrates against a warm photograph.

muted.$description: The album title, captions, states. Present, never competing.

line.$description: The one-pixel line. Used almost never.

fail.$description: A failed item. Desaturated on purpose: a red alert next to a photograph is an alarm in a gallery.

gutter.$description: Between photographs. Small enough that the set reads as one thing.

page-x.$description: Page margin. The photographs are the page.

title-y.$description: Above and below the album title.

tail.$description: After the last photograph, so the album ends rather than stops.

family.$description: System stack. No web font: an external request for a typeface is an external request (SDD.md 7.3).

title.$description: The album title. Small, tracked, upper case: a title page, not a masthead.

none.$description: Photographs are not rounded. A rounded photograph is a card.

card.$description: The PIN card and placeholder tiles only.

row-height.$description: Target row height the solver aims at on a wide screen.

phone-breakpoint.$description: Below this a row becomes a column.
